meta.title: refactor: Replace moment.js with date-fns
meta.body_summary: Replace moment.js with date-fns across the codebase to reduce bundle size and improve maintainability.

perf_labels.notes: Devin replaced moment with date-fns across 185 files without human review or benchmark; closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 6455 changed lines across 185 files, this is a large-scale refactor by absolute volume. It fits a broad library migration that was closed without merge, likely due to lack of review engagement and insufficient evidence.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal human review was performed; the PR received only bot comments (Devin integration notice, CodeRabbit skip). It was eventually closed without merge, likely due to inactivity or maintainer inability to validate the large migration.
review_details.performance_claim: Replace moment.js with date-fns to reduce bundle size and improve maintainability.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed after no human review and 8-day lifespan; no performance evidence provided.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Large-scale library migration across 185 files requires significant maintainer validation and performance benchmarking; without human engagement, the PR cannot be merged.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiler, or before/after bundle size comparisons; only narrative claim of improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without any regression analysis; no follow-up fixes.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced moment.js and moment-timezone dependencies with date-fns across the app/client codebase, updating date formatting, parsing, and validation logic in multiple components and utilities.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merge commit 1b1d28a from release branch introduced many unrelated changes; most large file churn (e.g., Snowflake test, Select styles) is not directly part of moment migration.
change_trajectory: Initial commit removed moment dependencies from package.json and yarn.lock.
Main replacement commit refactored files to use date-fns.
Subsequent commits fixed remaining moment references and lint/type errors.
Merge commit from release branch added unrelated changes.
Final fix commit addressed type errors; no human review occurred.

CodeRabbit skipped review because bot user detected.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with moment to date-fns migration.
Only bot comments appeared; no human review or feedback.
PR was closed without merge after ~8 days.
